description: User picks a refund in free text (not via the card): the agent calls refund_customer with the saved order id, the tool EXECUTES inline (first refund for this customer — the repeat-action guard only gates the second, see approval-pause), the agent reports the result honestly, and no workflow fires in the same turn. Rewritten 2026-08-22: the original (2026-07-15) asserted pendingApproval + approval wording from the approval='required' era; the tool moved to auto + repeat-guard on 2026-07-21 and this scenario was silently red until the CI gate caught it on its FIRST run.
